Gemma 4 Technical Report Google DeepMind arXiv

Here’s a concise guide to finding and evaluating technical reports related to Gemma 4, Google DeepMind, and arXiv.

What you might be looking for

Gemma 4 could refer to a specific project or model name under Google DeepMind or a related research initiative. It isn’t a widely known public label as of my knowledge cutoff, so the exact report might be under a code name or a forthcoming paper.

Google DeepMind publishes many technical reports and arXiv preprints about AI models, reinforcement learning, and machine learning systems. Key places to check:

arXiv: search terms like “Gemma”, “Gemma 4”, “DeepMind Gemma” or related model names.

DeepMind publications: https://www.deepmind.com/research

Google Research arXiv collections: https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=DeepMind

How to search effectively

Use site-specific searches:

arXiv: site:arxiv.org Gemma DeepMind

Google Scholar: Gemma DeepMind

Filter by year to find the most recent

Check author lists for DeepMind researchers (e.g., Demis Hassabis, Alice X. Zhang, etc.) and affiliations

What to look for in a technical report

Abstract: aims, problem statement, significance

Methods: model architecture, training procedures, datasets

Experiments: baselines, metrics, ablations, robustness

Limitations and ethics: safety, alignment, societal impacts

Reproducibility: code availability, data access, hyperparameters
